scientific_integrity: The algebraic proof establishes the infinite-family limits. Finite rational computations check representative parameters and do not independently certify the universal result; historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step full-size global Lanczos from identity, one inverse matrix function, an explicit growing-dimensional SPD family and ideal exact Hermite correction. No conclusion for finite-tolerance inner actions, other functions, other step counts, fixed-cost comparisons or general matrices.
title: A three-eigenvalue variance separation for Hermite-corrected global Lanczos
